title: Active Record Migrations
intro: Rails migrations are how the schema evolves, and the interview questions go well beyond 'how do you add a column'. The most important production topic is zero-downtime migrations — the add/backfill/remove three-step for adding a NOT NULL column to a large table without locking it. This page covers the change method and when to use up/down instead, the reversible do block for non-reversible DDL, the schema.rb vs structure.sql choice (use structure.sql when you use DB-specific features like partial indexes, triggers, or custom types), adding indexes (including expression indexes and partial indexes), the strong_migrations gem for catching dangerous migrations in CI, and running migrations safely in a blue-green or rolling deployment.
